papers.title: Average Energy Expended Per e-h Pair and Energy Scale Function for Germanium-Based Dark Matter Experiments
papers.summary: We report a new result of the temperature-dependent average energy expended per electron-hole (e-h) pair, $\varepsilon$, for germanium detectors. Applying energy partition mechanism in ionization for a given energy deposition, the Fano factor and the value of $\varepsilon$ can be determined separately.
